messages:
anya: quick sync — proposing we add an explicit "exposure" tag to audit event schema (values: internal, partner, customer, public). reason: makes customer-facing filtering + UI labeling canonical instead of ad-hoc string matching.

mike: +1. helps RBAC & routing too — we can gate events sent to external sinks by exposure.

sam: does this affect KMS metadata or key material visibility? we should ensure "internal" events never leak encrypted payloads to partners.

anya: good call. plan is exposure is orthogonal to existing actor/resource fields. KMS integrations should map exposure->encryption policy (e.g., internal -> never exported).

anya: example event (proposal):
```json
{
  "event": "key.rotate.request",
  "actor": "user:alice",
  "resource": "customer:acct-123",
  "exposure": "internal",
  "timestamp": "2025-11-02T17:02:33Z",
  "meta": { "route": "kms/v1/rotate" }
}
```

mike: nit: naming — prefer dotted verbs with domain first? like `kms.key.rotate.request` vs `key.rotate.request`. gives global uniqueness.

luis: Concern: changing names will break existing consumers. can we add `aliases` and deprecation windows? also need a migration plan for SIEMs.

anya: yes, support aliases and deprecation. suggested rollout: 1) schema add exposure + aliases, 2) lint warnings only for 1 release, 3) deprecate old names 6 months later.

"audit-lint-bot": lint: flagged 3 events with inconsistent verbs: `user.key_rotate` -> suggest `user.key.rotate.request`. see /lint-report/2523456789.

tess: product POV: for customer-facing UI we only surface events with exposure in [customer, public]. need a mapping doc so support knows which user-visible labels to show.

sam: also add an `exposure_reason` short enum to help audit reviewers (e.g., data_access, config_change, security_alert).

anya: agree. putting together a PR to schema repo with examples + migration checklist. action items: @mike draft alias plan, @luis sketch SIEM migration notes, @tess draft customer-visible label guide. i'll open RFC PR today.

mike: I'll start alias plan. quick Q — do we want `exposure` required or optional?

luis: optional for now to avoid brittle ingesters. enforce via lint for new events.

anya: makes sense — optional with lint rule. thanks all. :thumbsup: 

tess: +1, will prep support FAQ.

anya: filing RFC: https://go/repo/rfcs/2523456789 (WIP).
